csv_row.author: CaseMark
csv_row.description: Performs contract-driven compliance review of insurance certificates and endorsements against CRE/site-access and vendor agreement requirements. Produces pass/fail/conditional determinations, deficit lists, and broker-ready remediation instructions. Use when reviewing COI packets, ACORD 25 forms, or endorsements for additional insured, primary and non-contributory, waiver of subrogation, completed operations, umbrella alignment, limits adequacy, or insurer rating compliance. Trigger terms: COI, ACORD, additional insured, certificate holder, cancellation notice.
csv_row.name: insurance-certificate-compliance-check
